options.content:
**Time-picker scope:** Some panels on this dashboard honour the time-range picker (top-right); others are all-time and unaffected by it.

- **Time-picker-bounded** (results change when you narrow the range): Stat row, B-MPD, B-Q1, B-Q2, B-RC.
- **All-time / range-independent** (always show full dataset): B-Q4 (Model usage distribution), B-Q5 (Conversation length histogram).

Narrow the picker to e.g. "last 1 h" and all-time panels remain unchanged while bounded panels shrink accordingly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM conversations_dim;
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM messages_log;
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM agents_dim;

panels.title: Guardrail events
panels.description: PII/guardrail detection events. 0 is expected today (EDGE-001).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM guardrail_events_log;
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM dead_letter_log;

panels.title: Messages per day (B-MPD)
panels.description: PII-safe: selects only the day bucket and a count. Bounded by the time picker via $__timeFilter (PERF-001, EDGE-006/007).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(source_created_at, '1d') AS time, COUNT(*) AS messages FROM messages_log WHERE $__timeFilter(source_created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Model usage distribution — all-time (B-Q4)
panels.description: V-6 Q4 verbatim. Resolves agent traffic to underlying model via agents_dim. ALL-TIME — not bounded by the time picker (EDGE-007). Counts reflect the full dataset regardless of the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ad.model_underlying, ml.model_or_agent_id) AS resolved_model, COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM messages_log ml LEFT JOIN agents_dim ad ON ml.model_or_agent_id = ad.agent_id GROUP BY resolved_model ORDER BY message_count DESC;

panels.title: Top 10 users by message volume (B-Q1)
panels.description: V-6 Q1, adapted: the verbatim README query used a fixed literal INTERVAL '30 days'; replaced with $__timeFilter(source_created_at) so the time picker drives it (REQ-010 preferred resolution, MEDIUM-2). Selects user_id + count only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM messages_log WHERE $__timeFilter(source_created_at) GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY message_count DESC LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Conversation length histogram — all-time (B-Q5)
panels.description: V-6 Q5 verbatim. Full messages_log scan, acceptable at current scale (PERF-001). ALL-TIME — not bounded by the time picker. Counts reflect the full dataset regardless of the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN msg_count = 1 THEN '1' WHEN msg_count BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5' WHEN msg_count BETWEEN 6 AND 20 THEN '6-20' WHEN msg_count BETWEEN 21 AND 100 THEN '21-100' ELSE '100+' END AS length_bucket, COUNT(*) AS conversation_count FROM (SELECT conversation_id, COUNT(*) AS msg_count FROM messages_log WHERE conversation_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY conversation_id) sub GROUP BY length_bucket ORDER BY MIN(sub.msg_count);

panels.title: Agent error rates over time (B-Q2)
panels.description: V-6 Q2, adapted: the verbatim README query used DATE_TRUNC('day', ...) with a fixed literal INTERVAL '30 days'. Replaced with $__timeGroupAlias(ml.source_created_at, '1d') + $__timeFilter(ml.source_created_at) so the time picker drives it (REQ-010). source_created_at confirmed in messages_log (001_init.sql:71). Grouped by agent name via LEFT JOIN agents_dim. Uses Grafana Postgres time_series format — each COALESCE(ad.name, ml.model_or_agent_id) value becomes a separate series. At first prod deployment, verify this panel renders one line PER agent/model (multi-series), not a single merged series (LOW-3 acceptance check).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ml.source_created_at, '1d') AS time, COALESCE(ad.name, ml.model_or_agent_id) AS metric, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ml.error = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct FROM messages_log ml LEFT JOIN agents_dim ad ON ml.model_or_agent_id = ad.agent_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ml.source_created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Recent conversations (B-RC)
panels.description: Derived columns: conversations_dim has NO started_at/last_activity/message_count, so these are derived via subquery over messages_log (001_init.sql). Bounded by $__timeFilter on the inner scan before aggregating (PERF-001, messages_log_conversation_created_idx). NO title column (SEC-001 / OPEN-DECISION-001). IMPORTANT: started_at and message_count reflect only messages within the selected time range, NOT the conversation's full lifetime. A conversation older than the time window will show a started_at clamped to the window's left edge and a message_count that excludes pre-window messages. This is a deliberate PERF-001 tradeoff (bound-before-aggregate).

targets.rawSql: SELECT cd.conversation_id, cd.endpoint, cd.agent_id, agg.started_at, agg.last_activity, agg.message_count FROM conversations_dim cd JOIN (SELECT conversation_id, MIN(ml.source_created_at) AS started_at, MAX(ml.source_created_at) AS last_activity, COUNT(ml.message_id) AS message_count FROM messages_log ml WHERE conversation_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ml.source_created_at) GROUP BY conversation_id) agg ON agg.conversation_id = cd.conversation_id ORDER BY agg.last_activity DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: PII-trigger events (B-Q3)
panels.description: V-6 Q3, adapted: conversation_title DROPPED (SEC-001) — no join to conversations_dim. Selects only IDs/route/entity metadata/timestamp. triggered_at is gel.source_created_at (001_init.sql:111; guardrail_events_log has no triggered_at column). Renders gracefully on 0 rows (EDGE-001).

targets.rawSql: SELECT gel.conversation_id, gel.message_id, gel.route, gel.entity_count, gel.entity_types, gel.source_created_at AS triggered_at FROM guardrail_events_log gel WHERE gel.entity_count > 0 ORDER BY gel.source_created_at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Dead-letter inspector (B-DL)
panels.description: EXCLUDES the raw JSONB column (PII — the original failed source document, SEC-001). error_detail is already sanitized (SPEC-016).

targets.rawSql: SELECT source_collection, source_id, error_phase, error_detail, retry_count, last_failed_at FROM dead_letter_log ORDER BY last_failed_at DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Conversation content viewer (authorized use only)
panels.description: RAW CONTENT — authorized use only. Selects message text and conversation title (PII, SEC-001). Lives ONLY inside this collapsed drill-down row; not queried until the row is expanded (PII non-egress on default load).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ml.conversation_id, cd.title, ml.sender, ml.text, ml.source_created_at FROM messages_log ml LEFT JOIN conversations_dim cd ON ml.conversation_id = cd.conversation_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ml.source_created_at) ORDER BY ml.source_created_at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Message feedback text (authorized use only)
panels.description: RAW CONTENT — authorized use only. Selects feedback_text and message content (PII, SEC-001). Nested under the collapsed drill-down row; not queried until expanded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT message_id, conversation_id, feedback_rating, feedback_text, content, source_created_at FROM messages_log WHERE feedback_text IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(source_created_at) ORDER BY source_created_at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Dead-letter raw payload (authorized use only)
panels.description: RAW CONTENT — authorized use only. Exposes the dead_letter_log.raw JSONB original failed source document (PII, SEC-001). Nested under the collapsed drill-down row; not queried until expanded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source_collection, source_id, error_phase, raw, last_failed_at FROM dead_letter_log ORDER BY last_failed_at DESC LIMIT 50;
